verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a networking client like Tailscale, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, logging or usage-tracking opt-out. Related items, such as custom control server support or Pi-hole ad blocking, are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
